title: Specialist Result
description: Common output contract for every specialist branch (snake classification, dog visible-health screening, and future branches from Task 7+). This is a SCREENING result, never a diagnosis — see 'diagnosis' field, which must always be false for the dog-health branch.

animal.description: Which detected animal this specialist result is about.

specialist_type.description: Which specialist branch produced this result.

prediction.description: Primary predicted category. For snake_classification: likely_venomous | likely_non_venomous | unknown. For visible_health_screening: normal_visible_appearance | possible_wound | possible_skin_abnormality | possible_injury | unable_to_assess.

confidence.description: Model confidence in the visual classification/screening class ONLY. Never interpret as a medical/venom probability (Task 6 §19, §34, §59).

visibility.description: Whether the crop had enough visible evidence to support the prediction. If insufficient, prediction should be 'unknown' (snake) or 'unable_to_assess' (dog).

source_detection_id.description: Foreign key to the originating Task-5-style detection record (e.g. DET-00123).

secondary_prediction.description: Optional runner-up class, for reporting top-k alternatives.

region.description: Optional bounding region within the crop (e.g. for future segmentation-based localization). Not populated by the Phase 1 classification-only branches.

review_required.description: true for safety-sensitive predictions (e.g. likely_venomous, possible_wound/skin_abnormality/injury) — Task 6 §43-44, §58.

diagnosis.description: MUST always be false. This field exists specifically so no downstream consumer can mistake a screening result for a medical/veterinary diagnosis (Task 6 §2, §33).

recommendation.description: Suggested next step. Never an instruction to take automatic punitive action against the animal (Task 6 §38).

specialist_status.description: Set to 'invalid' if any required field could not be populated (Task 6 §62) — consumers must not act on an invalid result.
